'''Calamaria Surprise''' was a dish served by the dining establishment, [[BanthaQuik!]]. It included [[exosquidra poppets]].<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref> It was also served at [[Stargazer Grill Restaurant]] at [[Spaceport THX1138]].<ref name="Star Tours">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>
